results.title: Effects of inoculation interventions on impressions of mock political candidates
results.reason: This paper focuses on political psychology and misinformation interventions, not clinical psychology practice. It examines how inoculation interventions affect impressions of political candidates, which is outside the scope of therapy, assessment, diagnosis, mental health interventions, or clinical utility for practicing mental health professionals.

results.title: The RFT Perspective Taking Protocol has very poor reliability and convergent val
results.reason: This paper directly addresses psychometric properties of a measure (RFT Perspective Taking Protocol) used in clinical psychology contexts, examining reliability and validity which are critical for clinical assessment and diagnosis.
